text:
Nina: Idea: when browsing saved queries in the console, show a compact cost + token preview on hover. Small, non-blocking.
Raj: Love it. Helps when deciding to pin or change routing.
Ivy: We have token_count metrics but they're sampled. For hot routes we can upsample. For cold ones we should fall back to model defaults.
Bex: UX: show "est. cost / call" and "est. cost / 1k calls" + tiny variance indicator. Click to open breakdown.
Connor: API side: add `preview_cost` to saved_view_summary endpoint. Minimal fields only so payload stays small. Example returned blob: ```{
  "p50_tokens": 95,
  "p95_tokens": 420,
  "est_per_call_usd": 0.00019,
  "est_per_1k_usd": 0.19
}``` (that's pseudo).
Nina: How to handle routes that route to multiple models? Show blended estimate + a badge: "multi-model". Expand to see per-model split.
Ivy: We store routing policy versions, but not always weight history. If weights present, compute weighted avg; otherwise use primary-model fallback and mark as approximate.
Bex: Also add an age indicator: "computed 18m ago". Allow manual refresh but rate-limit refreshes per route (ops).
Raj: Telemetry: track `preview_shown`, `preview_expand`, `preview_refresh` events. For experiment, gate to 5-15% of orgs.
Connor: Ops: background recompute job should batch routes to avoid spikes. Add per-tenant throttle. And cache key should include routing_policy_id + model_version to invalidate on rollout.
ops-bot: deploy 1829182760: savedview-preview-cost -> staging passed :white_check_mark:
Ivy: Privacy: ensure estimates are aggregated across tenants and we don't expose individual request histograms. Use percentile summaries only.
Nina: I'll draft a short RFC: UI tiny badge + hover preview, backend cached endpoint + background recompute, telemetry + experiment plan, and ops throttles.
Bex: I'll mock the hover microcopy and the breakdown expander (Figma). Will include a "why estimate might differ" tooltip.
Raj: Sounds good. Quick follow-up: do we show currency conversion? Probably defer; keep USD for now.
Connor: Agreed. Also include a `stale` boolean in the API so UI can grey out stale estimates.
Nina: Thanks all, I'll post RFC link when ready.
